page.title: Optional Mods
page.description: Mods clients can join without. Optional IDs are kept out of the server's Mods= line, so the game never asks joining clients to install them.

how.title: How optional mods work
how.body: Project Zomboid disconnects a client when any advertised server mod is missing. This page solves that by not advertising the mod at all. The server will not load optional mods; clients that have them can still use them locally.

optional.title: Optional (non-required) mods
optional.description: Clients can join without these. Save the list, then apply it to remove them from the server's Mods= line.
optional.empty: No optional mods yet. Add one from the list on the right or move a required mod here.
optional.noMatches: No optional mods match your search.
optional.dirty: You have unsaved changes. Save the list, then apply it to rewrite the server INI.
optional.saved: Optional mod list saved. Apply it to update the server INI.
optional.savedRejected: Optional mod list saved. {{count}} invalid IDs were ignored.
optional.applied: Removed {{count}} mod(s) from the server's Mods= line. {{required}} required mods remain.
optional.nothingRemoved: No changes were needed; the server already excludes these mods.

available.title: Add a mod
available.description: Installed mods that are neither required nor optional. Pick one to make it optional.
available.empty: Every installed mod is already required or optional.
available.noMatches: No installed mods match your search.

required.title: Required mods ({{count}})
required.description: These IDs are in the server's Mods= line. Every joining client must have them installed.
required.empty: No required mods in the server INI.
required.noMatches: No required mods match your search.
required.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Use search to narrow the list.

restart.title: Restart needed
restart.body: Restart the Project Zomboid server from the Servers page so it reloads the INI with the new Mods= list.

errors.noPermission: You need the Mods permission to change optional mods.
errors.save: Could not save the optional mod list.
errors.apply: Could not apply the optional mod list to the server INI.
errors.noModsFolder: The active server's Zomboid data folder has no mods folder. Set the path on the server profile, then refresh.
errors.missingOptionalTitle: Some optional mods are not installed
errors.missingOptional: {{count}} optional ID(s) are not in the local mods folder. They stay excluded from the server, but clients that want them cannot load them until they are installed.
